thin_air.name: Thin Air
thin_air.desc: The air is thin here. You begin the fight with -1 Breath.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: This fight just started and you're already bleeding. Start missing 1 HP.

crazed.name: Crazed
crazed.desc: Its eyes are wrong. It lunges far more than it should.

heavy_rain.name: Heavy Rain
heavy_rain.desc: Rain drums in the dark, blurring your read of the forest. Calm reads more common this fight.

blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
blood_moon.desc: Red light through the canopy. The beast is swollen with power - but so is the harvest.

fog.name: Fog
fog.desc: Thick fog muffles the world. The forest runs hot and hard to read.
